experiments.research_question: What is Codex pass@3 on the three digest-pinned canary tasks under one elicitation?
experiments.hypothesis: With agent, k, environment, and instruction fixed, Codex pass@3 on the three canary members is a measurable baseline; later excursions are first harness-drift suspects.
experiments.primary_variable: task identity among the three canary-suite members
experiments.fixed_elicitation: agent=codex, adapter-default model (2026-08-15 jobs recorded gpt-5.6-terra), k=3, docker, no extra instruction
experiments.power_rationale: k=3 is the canary policy maximum and is below the lab comparison bar of k>=5 and TRUTH n_tasks>=2 paired ranking. These are three family observations, not a ranking.
experiments.next_action: Do not rank the three families. Follow html-js brief discriminator (EXP-N1) or stop expanding this slice.
experiments.decision_rule: Treat each family separately. Invalid 2026-08-14 ValueError trials stay outside the capability denominator. 2026-08-15 exception_info==null trials are the scored set.
experiments.stopping_condition: Stop claiming 'Codex unknown on canaries' once 2026-08-15 jobs are recorded. Stop ranking at n=3.
experiments.notes: 2026-08-14 first wave: 9/9 exception_type=ValueError 'Model name is required' (invalid harness). 2026-08-15: event-summary 3/3 reward 1.0; txn-recon 3/3 reward 1.0; html-js 0/3 reward 1.0; 0/9 exceptions. Original RUNNER specs were approved in the runner worktree and never dispatched there.
